name: Delete or Reorder Pages
tagline: Take out the pages you don't need, or put them in a new order, with a picture of every page.
seoTitle: Delete or reorder PDF pages without uploading
description: Remove pages from a PDF or change their order for free in your browser. See every page, then move, turn or delete it. Nothing is uploaded.

specs.Bookmarks: Kept when you only turn pages; not carried over when you delete or move pages
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The PDF is read and rebuilt inside this browser tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.
Yes. The new PDF is built only from the pages you keep, so a deleted page is not hidden inside the file. Your original file is not changed.

faq.q: Can I do this without dragging?
faq.a: Yes. Every page has buttons to move it earlier or later, turn it and delete it, and they work with a keyboard. You can also type the pages to delete, such as 2, 5-7.
